basis: Party Facts 4714 is Združena levica (United Left, 2014). The ID in The PopuList's file, 1403, is the Social Democrats (SD, earlier ZLSD). Party Facts' own list of The PopuList links the entry to 4714.
Party Facts 4713 is Kongres Nowej Prawicy (Congress of the New Right). The ID in The PopuList's file, 4714, is Slovenia's United Left.
Party Facts 8653 is solidaritéS. The ID in The PopuList's file, 2939, is a group of small parties. Party Facts' own list of The PopuList links the entry to 8653.
Party Facts 36 is Nieuw-Vlaamse Alliantie (N-VA). The ID in The PopuList's file, 756, is its cartel with CD&V of 2004 to 2007.

Party Facts 4094 is Eesti Konservatiivne Rahvaerakond (EKRE, since 2012). The ID in The PopuList's file, 110, is the People's Union of Estonia, one of its forerunners. Party Facts' own list of The PopuList links the entry to 4094.
Party Facts 1072 is Senterpartiet (Centre Party). The PopuList's file gives the entry no ID. Party Facts' own list of The PopuList links it to 1072.
Party Facts 3698 is Rødt (Red Party, since 2007). The ID in The PopuList's file, 44, is its forerunner, the Red Electoral Alliance. Party Facts' own list of The PopuList links the entry to 3698.

Party Facts 365 is Il Popolo della Libertà (2008 to 2013), the name of the entry in The PopuList's file. The ID in that file, 6241, and its English name stand for the Casa delle Libertà, the alliance of 2001 to 2006.
Party Facts 120 is Partidul Social Democrat (PSD). The ID in The PopuList's file, 1078, is the Romanian Socialist Democratic Party, which has an entry of its own with the same ID.

Party Facts 1410 is Lietuvos laisvės sąjunga, the far-right party that The PopuList's entry describes. The ID in The PopuList's file, 5456, is a liberal party of the same name, founded in 2014. Party Facts' own list of The PopuList links the entry to 1410.
Party Facts keeps a second ID, 276, for the same party under its earlier names (FDSN, PDSR); the Manifesto Project's code for PSD leads there.
The PopuList's entry is Vlaams Blok and Vlaams Belang together. Party Facts keeps Vlaams Blok under 553, the ID in The PopuList's file, and Vlaams Belang under 1968.
The PopuList's entry is the PDS and Die Linke together. Party Facts keeps the PDS under 86, the ID in The PopuList's file, and Die Linke under 1545.
Party Facts keeps Vasemmistoliitto (Left Alliance) under 1044 and its forerunner under 1096, the ID in The PopuList's file.
Party Facts keeps Sinistra Ecologia Libertà under 7031 as well as under 1212, the ID in The PopuList's file.
Same name and short name in both files (There Is Such a People, ITN). PPEG gives the party no Manifesto code.
Same name and short name in both files (National Front for the Salvation of Bulgaria, NFSB). PPEG gives the party no Manifesto code.
Same name and short name in both files (Bulgarian National Movement, VMRO). PPEG gives the party no Manifesto code.
An alliance. PPEG names GERB-SDS, the list on which GERB stands with the small Union of Democratic Forces; The PopuList's entry is GERB.
An alliance. PPEG names BSP for Bulgaria, the list of the Bulgarian Socialist Party; The PopuList's entry is the party.
An alliance. PPEG names BSP - United Left, the list of the Bulgarian Socialist Party; The PopuList's entry is the party.
Same name and short name in both files (Croatian Growth, Hrast). PPEG gives the party no Manifesto code.
Same name and short name in both files (Croatian Party of Rights Dr. Ante Starčević). PPEG gives the party no Manifesto code.
Same name and short name in both files (Christian National Union, ZChN). PPEG gives the party no Manifesto code.
The same party: Solidarna Polska, founded in 2012 and renamed Suwerenna Polska (Sovereign Poland) in 2023, the name in The PopuList's file. PPEG gives it no Manifesto code.
Same name in both files (Dawn of Nemunas). PPEG gives the party no Manifesto code.
Same name in both files (Sumar, in English Unite). Party Facts does not link PPEG's code for it.
Same name in both files (Res Publica). PPEG's Manifesto code leads to the ID of Isamaa, with which Res Publica merged in 2006; The PopuList's entry is Res Publica alone.
Same name in both files (For Fatherland and Freedom/LNNK). PPEG's Manifesto code leads to an ID that also holds the later National Alliance, which has an entry of its own in The PopuList.
An alliance. PPEG names the Alliance PSD and PC of 2008, the list of the Social Democratic Party; The PopuList's entry is the party.
Same name and short name in both files (Socialist Party of Slovenia, SSS). PPEG gives the party no Manifesto code.

Party Facts puts PPEG's code for the Social Democratic Union (USD), the alliance of the Democratic Party and the PSDR of 1996, under the ID of PSD. It is not the PSD of The PopuList, so the entry is not read for it.
Party Facts links the Social Democrats of the Global Populism Database (the party of Borut Pahor) to 472, the Slovenian Democratic Party. The Social Democrats are Party Facts 1403.
Party Facts 1595 is Les Républicains (The Republicans). The PopuList's file gives the entry no ID.
PPEG's ZL is the Associated List of Social Democrats of 1993. The PopuList's ZL is the United Left of 2014, another party with the same short name.
